turns.content: For 2-ethyl-2,6-dimethylcyclohexan-1-one, identify the enolizable alpha carbon under t-BuOK and trace its Michael addition to ethyl acrylate.
For 1-nitropropane with KOH and (E)-but-2-enenitrile, form the nitronate and trace its conjugate addition to the activated alkene.
Use the C6 enolate atom map to name the Michael-addition product of the cyclohexanone reaction with correct ring numbering.
Use both atom maps to state the two major products by their full names.
Check carbon conservation, retention of the ketone or nitrile, and the absence of a leaving group in both conjugate additions.
Report the two products and identify the nucleophile and electrophile in each reaction.
